opsproc.title: Thrust Reverser (ENG 1(2)REV PRESSURIZED alert displayed after deactivation)

command.para: Determine the associated Flight Manual performance penalties with the OCTOPUS program.

unlist.para: In the Airbus EFB PERF applications:

item.para: If one engine reverser is inoperative, this correspond to the MEL item “THRUST REVERSERS CREDIT ONE REVERSER INOPERATIVE"
If both engine reversers are inoperative, this correspond to the MEL item “THRUST REVERSERS CREDIT ALL REVERSERS INOPERATIVE".

command.para: When the FADEC associated with the inoperative thrust reverser have power:

item.para: Confirm that the ENG 1(2)REV INHIBITED alert associated with the inoperative thrust reverser is displayed on the EWD, and
Disregard the ENG 1(2)REV PRESSURIZED alert associated with the inoperative thrust reverser displayed on the EWD.

unlist.title: During the takeoff briefing, the flight crew must review:

item.para: The status of the thrust reversers, and
The use of the thrust reversers

command.para: Ensure that both engine thrust levers are set to IDLE detent, then:

condition.subtitle: false
condition.intro: If one thrust reverser is inoperative:

command.para: Use both thrust levers when applying reverse thrust.

condition.subtitle: false
condition.intro: If both thrust reversers are inoperative:

command.para: Do not move the thrust levers to reverse.

unlist.title: During the approach briefing, the flight crew must review:

item.para: The status of the thrust reversers, and
The use of the thrust reversers

command.para: Before the touchdown, ensure that both engine thrust levers are set to IDLE detent for the flare.

condition.subtitle: false
condition.intro: After touchdown, if one thrust reverser is inoperative:

command.para: Use both thrust levers when applying reverse thrust.

inform.para: For automatic roll-out with one thrust reverser inoperative, .

condition.subtitle: false
condition.intro: After touchdown, if both thrust reversers are inoperative:

command.para: Do not move the thrust levers to reverse.
